**What does this change, and why?**

---

- [ ] Tests and linters pass locally (see the project's CONTRIBUTING for the command)
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or real personal data in the diff

**If it changes how a figure is displayed:** a missing value should still read as missing —
not `0`, not a blank cell. Several of these projects treat that as the difference between
reporting and inventing.

**If it changes user-facing text:** check whether the project ships more than one language,
and update all of them.

Thanks for taking the time. If something in the setup did not work, say so in the pull
request — a broken contributor path is a bug in the project, not in you.
